# local 0016: mcs51 --xstack: the result of a call in r0 is overwritten when one register is restored from the external stack

- Category: [Problems without a ticket and without a patch](../../unreported.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17228
- Recommended action: In unsaveRegisters(), keep r0 in the branch for one register when the result of the call is in r0.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

On r17228 with `--xstack`, `sum()` of the program below returns 9, and 5 is correct.

```c
__data unsigned char a[3] = {1, 2, 4};
__xdata __at (0x7000) volatile unsigned char result;

__data unsigned char *elem (unsigned char i) { return &a[i]; }

unsigned char
sum (void)
{
  __data unsigned char *p = elem (0);
  __data unsigned char *q = elem (2);

  return *p + *q;
}

void main (void) { result = sum (); for (;;); }
```

With `sdcc -mmcs51 --stack-auto --xstack -S r0.c`, the instructions after the second `lcall _elem`
are `mov r0,spx`, `dec r0`, `movx a,@r0`, `mov r1,a`, `dec spx`, `mov ar7,@r1`, and `mov a,@r0`.
`p` is in r1, which the code stores on the external stack before the call, and the result `q` is
in r0. With `--no-peep`, `mov r0, dpl` follows the `lcall`, and the peephole optimizer removes it.
`mov a,@r0` reads internal RAM at the address that r0 has after the restore of r1.

In uCsim, the program stores 9 at xdata 0x7000 with `--stack-auto --xstack`, with
`--stack-auto --xstack --opt-code-size`, with `--xstack`, with `--model-large --xstack`, and with
`--model-large --stack-auto --xstack`. It stores 5 with `--stack-auto` and with `--model-large`.
A default build does not make a library for `--xstack`. The first two programs were linked with
`mcs51-small-xstack-auto`, built by `make -C device/lib model-mcs51-small-xstack-auto` in a tree
of r17228 with the patches of this report. The other three were linked with the library of their
model without `--xstack`, and the linker warns about conflicting options. Each program with
`--xstack` was linked with a copy of `crtxstack.s` in which `_spx` is `spx` (see local 0020).

## Cause

In `unsaveRegisters()` in `src/mcs51/gen.c`, the branch `count == 1` for `options.useXstack` emits
`mov r0,spx` and does not test whether the result of the call is in r0. The branch for two or more
registers has that test in `resultInR0`. It pushes r0 before `mov r0,spx` and pops it after the
last register. The lines of the branch `count == 1` are from
[r3576](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/3576/), and
[r5662](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/5662/) added `resultInR0` to the other branch only.

## Open

A patch is not offered. The branch `count == 1` can push r0 before `mov r0,spx` and pop it after
`dec spx` when the result is in r0. That change was not made.

## Related

- Local 0020 is the reason for the copy of `crtxstack.s`. Since
  [r17225](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/17225/), a program with `--xstack` links with
  `?ASlink-Warning-Undefined Global _spx`, and sdcc exits with status 1. The patch of local 0020
  makes in `crtxstack.s` the change that the copy has.
- Bug #4253 and bug #4254 are about a result in A or B that the same restore overwrites. With the
  patch for them, `sum()` also returns 9.
